newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Talks with NZ First not the last - Labour's Clark.
newsitem.headline: Talks with NZ First not the last - Labour's Clark.

text.p: New Zealand Labour leader Helen Clark entered fresh coalition negotiations with the nationalist New Zealand First Party on Wednesday saying it was "most certainly not" the last meeting between the two parties.
Asked if Labour had given New Zealand First a final draft of a coalition proposal, Clark answered: "We are exchanging documents all the time".
Clark also said Labour was likely to meet again with the left-wing Alliance Party but nothing had been scheduled.
Earlier, a Labour spokesman said the party and New Zealand First had exchanged papers covering policy issues and allocation of ministerial portfolios.

The caretaker National Party government and centre-left Labour have both been negotiating to form a government with NZ First since an inconclusive general election on October 12. Parliament is due to convene for the first time by December 13.
